name: agent-loop
description: Build a codebase with parallel Claude Code agents: a worker per task, a separate critic per PR, CI-gated merges and a scorecard per wave.

scripts.check:syntax: find claude -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.cjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n1 sh -c 'node --check --input-type=module - < "$0" 2>/dev/null || { echo "(async function(){"; sed "s/^export //" "$0"; echo "})"; } | node --check --input-type=commonjs - || { echo "syntax error in $0" >&2; exit 1; }'
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:py && node scripts/bundle-workflows.js --check && vitest run
